card.title: The Secrecy Protocol
card.instruction: Treat concealment as a precise ritual with passwords, signals, approved phrases, and severe consequences for careless improvisation.

transfer.action: I require the written picnic password before handing over {prop}.
transfer.opening: Write the password. Speaking it cancels collection. {request}
transfer.response: Use the approved signal instead of saying the name aloud. {counter}
transfer.challenge: It's only lunch. Cucumber, wasn't it?
transfer.closing: You've said it. Collection is cancelled. I'll tell the walkers their lunch failed clearance.

originalTransfer.action: I tap three times before indicating {prop}.
originalTransfer.opening: Password first. Then the ordinary conversation. {request}
originalTransfer.response: Use the approved gesture rather than the name. {counter}
originalTransfer.closing: Then keeping the lunch password should be wonderfully manageable.

originalDialogue.speaker: A

beats.speaker: B

card.title: The Secrecy Protocol
card.instruction: Treat concealment as a precise ritual with passwords, signals, approved phrases, and severe consequences for careless improvisation.

originalDialogue.speaker: A
originalDialogue.text: Signal the cupboard with three fingers. Don't say where the cake is.

originalDialogue.speaker: A
originalDialogue.text: That information requires the cake briefing.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Signal Mum's birthday cake location: three fingers for cupboard, four for fridge. Say it aloud and you're off the surprise team.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's on the table. The helpers need to find it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're off. Table is a flat palm. I'll signal them.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I've already sent them a photo. That doesn't say anything.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: It shows everything. Now we move the cake and change the signals. You won't be told where your slice is.

bindings.scope: Fresh binding-only review of an explicit transfer-body amendment. Read the exact card, both original and accepted candidate single dialogues, and every original/proposed transfer field. Are the proposed fields faithful to the exact mechanism and their described source material? Identify real residual contradictions or unsupported details. Seed hashes still describe the historical originals; validated integration will bind the accepted dialogue only after your compatibility assessment. A compiled transfer is not an individually reviewed pair. Do not score single or pair dialogue; records must be empty. No writer scores or improvement claims are supplied.
